plan.notes: Source: official Alfred State College 2025-2026 Catalog (catalog PDF, 'Alfred State College Catalog 2025-2026 Catalog'), Degree Maps section: 'Computer Science (AS)', plus the college's program page https://www.alfredstate.edu/academics/majors-and-programs/computer-science ('2 Years Associate of Science'; 'This AS degree is specifically designed to maximize transfer credit to four-year programs'). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the catalog's 'typical 4 semester degree plan' degree map and course description pages (titles, credit hours, prerequisites verified per course). Credit math: Fall Y1 3+3+3+4+3=16, Spring Y1 3+4+3+3+3=16, Fall Y2 3+3+3+4+3=16, Spring Y2 3+3+3+3+3=15; total 63. Discrepancy documented honestly: graduation requirements state a minimum of 62 credit hours, and the degree map header states Total Degree Map Credits 60-63; the transcribed typical sequence sums to 63, so total_credits=63 (the sequence's own published total). Catalog mislabel note: the degree map's left column labels the Year 1 Spring block as 'Year 2 Spring' (the header is a catalog error); reading order and course progression identify it as Spring Year 1 (MATH1084 Calculus I after Fall MATH1054; CISY2133 Programming II after Fall CISY1113). The stray 'General Education Elective (Generic)' at the top of the right column is assigned to Spring Year 1 as its fifth slot. Degree Map Effective Catalog Year is printed as '2009 -' (map in continuous use); catalog year recorded is the 2025-2026 source edition. Placement caveats from the catalog (not encoded as course prereqs): if students do not place into MATH 1033/1084/1323/1034/1054/2124, MATH 1014 Algebra Concepts is a required prerequisite for the major; if they do not place into PHYS 1024/1044, PHYS 1014 Introductory Physics is required. Graduation requirements: minimum 24 credit hours of required CISY courses plus one professional elective approved by adviser, 2.0 cumulative index, minimum 62 credit hours with 30 in liberal arts. CISY2133: catalog Free Form Requirements list CISY1023; CISY1113 added per the degree map's own sequencing (Year 1 Fall before Year 1 Spring). CISY2153 full title expanded from catalog truncation 'Database Appl and Programng I' to 'Database Applications and Programming I'; CISY3193 from 'Computer Architecture & Organi' to 'Computer Architecture & Organization'; CISY4003 from 'Comp Prgrmming III/Data Strctu' to 'Computer Programming III/Data Structures'.
